items.claim: Navajo Sterling took the fight against Jan Blachowicz on short notice.
items.quote: And now Navajo steps in on short notice against Jan.

items.claim: Sterling is undefeated despite taking a big step up in competition.
items.quote: Sterling is undefeated with a big step up in competition.

items.claim: Sterling has good submission defense and pops right back up when taken down.
items.quote: very good submission defense. He has been taken down before, but he pops right back up.

items.claim: Jan Blachowicz has dealt with a lot of injuries.
items.quote: We know Jan has had a lot of injuries

items.claim: Jan Blachowicz is very good at checking low kicks.
items.quote: He can check low kicks very very well.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez was in prison for eight months after being caught crossing the border with marijuana.
items.quote: he was in prison for eight months because he caught he got caught crossing the border with a small amount of marijuana.
